newsitem.title: USA: Auto sales in U.S. off 1.7 pct April 21-30 -- CNW.
newsitem.headline: Auto sales in U.S. off 1.7 pct April 21-30 -- CNW.

text.p: Auto sales in the United States fell 1.7 percent in the 10 days of April 21-30 compared with the same period a year ago, according to a report by CNW Marketing/Research.
During the survey period, sales of domestic autos decreased 3.1 percent, while U.S. sales of imports gained 6.2 percent.
Specifically, domestic car sales fell 6.0 percent to 283,567 from 301,777, CNW said. Domestic truck sales rose 1.1 percent, to 211,112 from 208,835, it said.
Import car sales advanced 6.4 percent at 89,591, and import truck sales rose 4.1 percent to 9,216, the report said.
Year-to-date vehicle sales in the United States reached 4,907,184, off 0.6 percent from the same period of 1996, according to CNW.
